title: Typed calendar groups
brief: Group timestamps into typed calendar periods.
instructions: Count paid orders in observed UTC 2024 months. Return each month as DATE, not formatted text. Empty months are absent.
For paid reporting activity, include timestamps at or after 2024-01-01 00:00:00 UTC and exclude timestamps at or after 2025-01-01 00:00:00 UTC.
Return only the declared output columns, in their declared order and exact SQL types. Follow the output ordering contract; NULL ordering is explicit.
starterExplanation: This starter exposes order_id,ordered_at,status from orders without solving typed calendar groups.

hints.text: Truncate UTC time to a calendar month and return a DATE.
Group qualifying orders by the same typed month expression.
The locally February timestamp on order 3 belongs to January in UTC.
